title: Samarth Para Sports Programme
description: High-performance Para-sports preparation for the Asian Para Games and Paralympics, supported by Hyundai Motor India Foundation.
lede: High-performance Para-sports preparation for the Asian Para Games and Paralympics, supported by Hyundai Motor India Foundation.

paragraphs: Launched in 2024, Samarth helps India's elite and emerging Para Athletes prepare for the Asian Para Games 2026, Commonwealth Games 2026, and 2028 Paralympics, through holistic, athlete-centric support.
In FY 2025–26, the programme supported 20 Para Athletes across 9 sports and 6 states, receiving 1,231 interventions spanning physiotherapy, nutrition, assistive devices, and high-performance stints.
These interventions contributed to 68 medals, including 38 international, with 9 gold medals at the 24th National Para Athletics Championships alone.

image.alt: Yash Kumar training on the water in his canoe

story.name: Yash Kumar
paragraphs: The story: Accessibility challenges at home affected his independence, added physical strain, and disrupted his training routine.
The GSF impact: Samarth supported relocation to a wheelchair-accessible home near his training centre, a high-performance camp in Europe, and customised canoe seating and equipment.
The result: Represented India at the World Championships, won Bronze at the ICF World Para Canoe Cup, and was honoured with the Laxman Award.

items.quote: “With the support of the Samarth Parasports Programme, I received excellent rehabilitation and came back stronger — winning three gold medals at the National Championships since.”
items.name: Sathi Mondal

items.quote: “Your support with training, competition expenses, nutrition, coaching, sports psychology, recovery, and performance analysis has helped me focus on my training and perform at my best.”
items.name: Rachana Patel
